prompt: How do CSF 2.0 informative references work, and how do we map our ISO 27001 controls to CSF?
assertions: Explains informative references as crosswalks mapping CSF 2.0 outcomes (functions/categories/subcategories) to other standards and resources
Points to NIST SP 1347, the CSF 2.0 Informative References Quick-Start Guide, finalized August 2026
Mentions the CSF 2.0 Reference Tool for browsing/exporting reference data
Mentions the OLIR (Online Informative References) program as the mechanism behind the mappings
Demonstrates a concrete mapping use: e.g., ISO 27001/SP 800-53/CIS Controls mapped against CSF subcategories for gap or evidence reuse
